test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following state government's Medical and Health Departments has been awarded by WHO (in the year 2019) for its achievements in the field of tobacco control?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The World Health Organization awarded the Rajasthan government’s **Medical & Health Department its Tobacco Control Award for the year 2019.**
 
• **Rohit Kumar Singh**, Additional Chief Secretary, Medical, Health & Family Welfare, received the award.
 
• He received at the National Consultation on Tobacco & Lung Health on** 31st May 2019 i**n New Delhi.
 
• The award was conferred by the World Health Organization on the occasion of World No Tobacco Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The medical and health department of Rajasthan is one of the two from India selected for the ‘World No Tobacco Day Award for 2019’.**
 
• **WHO** selected **33 institutions **and individuals across the world for the award.
 
• In the Southeast Asian region, two have been selected from India.
 
• One is the Rajasthan government and the other is Prof Raj Kumar, director, Vallabhbhai Patel Chest Institute, New Delhi.
